title: HSK2 Gate 20 · Early Qing
explanationEn: Gate 20: Early Qing. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第20关：清前期。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 清朝有一个很有名的皇帝，叫康熙。他八岁的时候就做了皇帝。因为他还很小，所以一开始有别人帮他。他十几岁的时候，才开始自己做事。
passageEn: The Qing dynasty had a famous emperor called Kangxi. He became emperor at the age of eight. Because he was so young, others helped him at first. Only in his teens did he begin to rule himself.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: The Qing dynasty had a famous emperor called Kangxi.
comprehension.answer: 清朝有一个很有名的皇帝，叫康熙。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Because he was so young, others helped him at first.
comprehension.answer: 因为他还很小，所以一开始有别人帮他。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Early Qing in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说清前期。
